headline: W. R. Berkley Corporation Names Christopher L. Moede President of Berkley Risk
summary: GREENWICH, Conn., July 28, 2026--W. R. Berkley Corporation (NYSE: WRB) today announced the appointment of Christopher L. Moede as president of Berkley Risk. He succeeds John ("Jack") M. Goodwin, who has been named chairman of the business. The appointments are effective immediately.
